name: Amazon Brand Registry
description: Protect intellectual property, unlock A+ Content, Brand Stores, and automated counterfeit takedown tools.
fullDescription: Amazon Brand Registry gives trademark owners powerful tools to safeguard intellectual property, build a branded storefront, and access advanced seller analytics. Registered brands gain access to Brand Analytics, A+ Content modules, Sponsored Brands advertising, and automated IP protection algorithms.
features: Predictive protection algorithms that automatically block infringement before publication
Report a Violation (RAV) tool with fast-track investigation by Amazon legal
Access to A+ Enhanced Brand Content and immersive Amazon Brand Stores
Unlock Amazon Brand Analytics for search query reports and market basket analysis
Project Zero and Transparency serial code barcode counterfeit defense
